neighbours.label: the adjective or possessive that opens praise of a person's personal qualities ('has great energy', 'her tremendous work ethic', 'his outgoing personality'), as against the same adjectives praising objects, places or plain facts
fire: Everyone in the clubhouse says the young catcher has great leadership and a quick wit.
Teammates point to her tremendous competitive drive as the reason for their title run.
I happily recommend Daniel; he has a generous spirit and a sharp eye for detail.
Fans adore the striker because of his cheerful, outgoing nature off the pitch.
The coach praised the rookie for his incredible poise during the final drive.
Our office manager is known for her remarkable patience with every new hire.
Scouts rave about the point guard, saying she has fantastic vision and a calm temperament.
Several former players credited the veteran's tireless work ethic for their own growth.
quiet: Everyone in the clubhouse says the new ballpark has great sightlines and quick concessions.
Reporters point to the tremendous new scoreboard as the arena's biggest upgrade.
I happily recommend this hotel; it has a generous breakfast and a quiet courtyard.
Fans adore the stadium because of its cheerful, open concourse near the river.
The coach praised the turf for its incredible grip during the final drive.
Our office is known for its remarkable view of the harbor from every desk.
Scouts note that the point guard signed a two-year deal worth six million dollars.
Several former players attended the veteran's retirement dinner on Saturday.

predictions: fire 0.35-0.7 on the praising adjective about a person's character or temperament; the same adjectives about things or facts about the person below 0.2
notes: Card: ' great' x5, ' his' x5, 'outgoing personalities', 'He has great energy', 'tough journey', almost all sports/recommendation praise of a person. Probe: 'rookie has great energy' 0.671, 'her tremendous work ethic' 0.675, 'his outgoing personality' 0.420, 'she has a warm manner' 0.366; 'stadium has great parking' 0.155, 'rookie has a contract' 0.241, 'team had a great offseason' 0.273. Near misses keep sports framing with object praise, so a leak around 0.25 is possible.
